consent_revocation.name: consent_revocation

player_mother_height.name: player_mother_height

player_father_height.name: player_father_height

test_result_status.value: ("test_result"."status" = 'done' and "test_result"."not_done_reason" is null and "test_result"."method" is not null) or ("test_result"."status" = 'not_done' and "test_result"."not_done_reason" is not null)

test_result_value_voided_by.name: test_result_value_voided_by

gym_set_load.name: gym_set_load

invitation_revoked_by.name: invitation_revoked_by
invitation_revoked_by.value: "invitation"."revoked_by" is null or "invitation"."revoked_at" is not null

hold_lift.name: hold_lift
